zodomusDebug.title: Zodomus debug
zodomusDebug.subtitle: SUPERADMIN only · same-origin API proxy (/api/v1 → Nest)
zodomusDebug.headerIntro: Manually exercise the Zodomus integration and inspect responses. Fields below apply to all sections.
zodomusDebug.hintProperty: RentAI property row. For buttons that need propertyId, pick an item from the list first.
zodomusDebug.hintChannel: OTA channel id in Zodomus (often 1). Confirm in your Zodomus channel settings.
zodomusDebug.hintForce: When on: run sync or sync-all even if the server would otherwise skip them.
zodomusDebug.zoneAHelp:
What: standard backend routes — integration status, sync one property or whole channel, import summary, push availability to OTA.

How to verify: (1) Select Property if the button is not disabled. (2) GET status — expect 200 and a JSON status. (3) POST sync — refresh data for the selected property; check the Log panel on the right. (4) POST sync-all — all properties on this channelId. (5) import-summary / push-availability — after Zodomus config changes or calendar checks.
zodomusDebug.zoneActivationHelp:
Wie Postman, Zugangsdaten auf dem Server, Antwort im Log.

Lange OTA-Property-Id gehört nach zodomusPropertyId in RentAI. Preismodell-Feld nur 1–5 aus GET /price-model.

Weiteres Objekt: neue Zeile + neue Id + einmal aktivieren.
zodomusDebug.zoneBHelp: Zimmer/Tarife, Warteschlange, Verfügbarkeit, Testbuchung. Property mit zodomusPropertyId wählen.
zodomusDebug.hintPriceModelId: Nur id aus models[] (1, 2, 3…). Nicht die OTA-Property-Id.
zodomusDebug.zoneBCreatetestHelp: E2E (sandbox): POST /reservations-createtest creates a test booking in Zodomus. Dates and guest name are not part of this API — Zodomus generates them. If your webhook URL is configured in Zodomus, it will call your backend — then run sync and check the calendar.
zodomusDebug.webhookHelp:
What: send a body similar to an inbound channel webhook (no JWT — typical Zodomus setup).

How to verify: selected Property must have zodomusPropertyId. If ZODOMUS_WEBHOOK_KEY is set in .env, paste the same key. Set reservationId and status: 1=new, 2=modification, 3=cancel. Click POST webhook and inspect status and body on the right.
zodomusDebug.zoneCHelp:
What: scripts under doc/zodomus / repo root; run in a terminal with your .env, not in the browser.

How to verify: copy the command, run it from the project root (pnpm …); read stdout for property-activation, property-check, etc.
zodomusDebug.logHelp: Recent actions from this page. Click a row for response/request body. Green code — 2xx success; red — error, read the JSON message.
zodomusDebug.logEmpty: No requests yet — use a button on the left.
